newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Mystery fever kills 34 in Central African Republic.
newsitem.headline: Mystery fever kills 34 in Central African Republic.

text.p: A mystery fever has killed 34 people in the north of the Central African Republic near the border with Sudan, state radio reported on Wednesday.
The health ministry planned to send a team of experts to the Vakaga region where a further 114 people had fallen ill with the disease, it said.
It was not immediately clear when the outbreak began.
